rows.note: This is the everyday choice when something is done or supplied more than sufficiently.

example.english: We’ve amply stocked up on food for the trip, so we don’t need to buy any more.
example.traditional: 旅行啲食物我哋準備得夠晒，唔使再買。
example.jyutping: leoi5 hang4 di1 sik6 mat6 ngo5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 dak1 gau3 saai3 m4 sai2 zoi3 maai5

rows.note: Use this as the more general choice for doing something fully or to an ample extent.

example.english: The school amply considered the parents’ opinions before putting the new arrangement into effect.
example.traditional: 學校充分咁考慮咗家長嘅意見，先至落實新安排。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 cung1 fan6 gam3 haau2 leoi6 zo2 gaa1 zoeng2 ge3 ji3 gin3 sin1 zi3 lok6 sat6 san1 on1 paai4

rows.note: Use this only for the thoroughly or completely aspect of “amply,” not simply for having enough.

example.english: We thoroughly inspected the machine, and the inspection amply covered every important detail.
example.traditional: 我哋徹底咁檢查咗部機，連最細嘅螺絲都冇放過。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 cit3 dai2 gam3 gim2 caa4 zo2 bou6 gei1 lin4 zeoi3 sai3 ge3 lo4 si1 dou1 mou5 fong3 gwo3
